answer: This DKG variant publishes every complaint on a shared transcript, and the beacon of the protocol is that anyone can replay the complaint and confirm who cheated. The quartz of the design is that misbehaving dealers lose their slot before the key is finalized, so the group key is built only from verified contributions. A Sybil ring gains nothing from flooding the group because each participant's contribution is weighted equally and checked independently, and the wharf of the transcript is the audit trail that keeps the quorum honest.
